Tool generates JSON output (_agents/wim_compliance_report.json) with fields: file_path, compliance_score (0-100), violation_count, violations (array of {type, location, suggestion}). Returns exit code 1 if any file <95% compliant or <5 BEV/Aesthetic/IT directories scanned
